authoritySource: Explicit human direction in the active Codex design and implementation thread.

requestedChange.removeDependency: Any unreleased .NET SDK or future deterministic NuGet-pack capability.
requestedChange.controlledMechanism: Use repository-owned package canonicalization and make the GitHub workflow reconcile deterministic unsigned candidate bytes with NuGet.org repository-signed published bytes.
requestedChange.releaseLifecycle: Permit the human-started workflow to publish the analyzer first, derive its exact NuGet.org-signed identity, finalize the installed alpha.3 CLI selection catalog, qualify that final package set, and then publish the remaining packages.
requestedChange.acceptedRisk: An alpha.3 analyzer package may remain immutably published if a later workflow phase fails; a safe retry must verify the existing published package before resuming and must never overwrite it.

publicationBoundary: Implementation may change and verify the workflow source but may not invoke it, create or move tags, publish packages, or create GitHub Release state. A later explicit human action starts publication.
